# Customer Service Call Summary and Case Note
Case ID: CS-88421-B
Representative: Marcus Vance (Ext. 4012)
Date: 03/18/2026
Customer: Elena Rostova
Account ID: ACCT-90421

## Order Details
| Item SKU | Description | Qty | Unit Price | Line Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| HM-410 | Ceramic Planter 10in | 2 | $24.00 | $48.00 |
| HM-112 | Brass Watering Can | 1 | $35.00 | $35.00 |
| HM-804 | Organic Potting Mix 8qt | 3 | $12.00 | $36.00 |
| Total | | 6 | | $119.00 |

## Customer Inquiry Details
Customer called at 10:14 AM EST regarding order ORD-55102 placed on 03/10/2026 and delivered on 03/17/2026 via FedEx Ground. Customer stated that parcel tracking indicated complete delivery of the entire package, but the Brass Watering Can was missing from the box upon opening.

- Customer confirmed shipping carton arrived undamaged without external tampering.
- Warehouse inventory log reviewed; SKU HM-112 was flagged as backordered at fulfillment center FC-3 on 03/11/2026.
- Advised customer that the missing Brass Watering Can was omitted from shipment due to stock shortage.
- Processed refund for the missing item totaling $48.00 back to original payment method.
- Advised customer to allow 3 to 5 business days for bank processing.
- Issued complimentary shipping coupon for next purchase via email.

## Next Steps
- Sent confirmation email to customer address on file.
- No further agent actions required; case closed on first contact.
